## Sheet1

| 题目类型 | 题干 | 难度（1-5） | 知识点标签 | 解析 | 适用场景 | 题目文件名 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 选择题(单选) | $\cos 345^\circ$ 的值为（　　）   A. $\dfrac{\sqrt{2}-\sqrt{6}}{4}$　　B. $\dfrac{\sqrt{6}-\sqrt{2}}{4}$　　C. $\dfrac{\sqrt{2}+\sqrt{6}}{4}$　　D. $-\dfrac{\sqrt{2}+\sqrt{6}}{4}$ | 2 | 余弦和角;诱导公式 | 答案: C \| 解析: $\cos 345^\circ = \cos(-15^\circ + 360^\circ) = \cos(-15^\circ) = \cos 15^\circ = \cos(45^\circ - 30^\circ) = \cos 45^\circ \cos 30^\circ + \sin 45^\circ \sin 30^\circ = \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} \times \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} + \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} \times \frac{1}{2} = \frac{\sqrt{6} + \sqrt{2}}{4}$．故选C． | 课堂演练 |  |
| 选择题(单选) | $\sin 7^\circ \cos 23^\circ + \sin 83^\circ \cos 67^\circ$ 的值为（　　）   A. $-\dfrac{1}{2}$　　B. $\dfrac{1}{2}$　　C. $\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$　　D. $-\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$ | 2 | 余弦差角;诱导公式 | 答案: B   解析: $\sin 7^\circ \cos 23^\circ + \sin 83^\circ \cos 67^\circ = \cos 83^\circ \cos 23^\circ + \sin 83^\circ \sin 23^\circ = \cos(83^\circ - 23^\circ) = \cos 60^\circ = \dfrac{1}{2}$． | 课堂演练 |  |
| 选择题(多选) | （多选）若 $\alpha \in [0, 2\pi]$，$\sin \frac{\alpha}{3} \sin \frac{4\alpha}{3} + \cos \frac{\alpha}{3} \cos \frac{4\alpha}{3} = 0$，则 $\alpha$ 的值可能是（　　）   A. $\dfrac{\pi}{6}$　　B. $\dfrac{\pi}{4}$　　C. $\dfrac{\pi}{2}$　　D. $\dfrac{3\pi}{2}$ | 3 | 余弦差角;解方程 | 答案: CD   解析: 因为 $\alpha \in [0, 2\pi]$，   $$ \sin \frac{\alpha}{3} \sin \frac{4\alpha}{3} + \cos \frac{\alpha}{3} \cos \frac{4\alpha}{3}  = \cos \left( \frac{\alpha}{3} - \frac{4\alpha}{3} \right)  = \cos (-\alpha)  = \cos \alpha = 0, $$   则 $\alpha = \dfrac{\pi}{2}$ 或 $\alpha = \dfrac{3\pi}{2}$．故选 CD． | 课后巩固 |  |
| 选择题(单选) | 若 $\cos(\alpha-\beta)=\frac{1}{3}$，则 $(\sin \alpha+\sin \beta)^2+(\cos \alpha+\cos \beta)^2 = (\quad)$   A. $\dfrac{8}{3}$　　B. $-\dfrac{8}{3}$　　C. $\dfrac{22}{3}$　　D. $-\dfrac{22}{3}$ | 3 | 余弦差角;代数变形 | 答案: A   解析: 原式＝$2 + 2(\sin \alpha \sin \beta + \cos \alpha \cos \beta) = 2 + 2\cos(\alpha - \beta) = 2 + 2 \times \dfrac{1}{3} = \dfrac{8}{3}$． | 课后巩固 |  |
| 选择题(单选) | 计算$\dfrac{\cos\left(\dfrac{\pi}{4}-\alpha\right)}{\sin \alpha+\cos \alpha}$的值是（　　）   A. $\sqrt{2}$　　B. $-\sqrt{2}$　　C. $\dfrac{\sqrt{2}}{2}$　　D. $-\dfrac{\sqrt{2}}{2}$ | 2 | 余弦差角;化简求值 | 答案: C \| 解析: $\displaystyle \frac{\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{4}-\alpha\right)}{\sin \alpha+\cos \alpha}=\frac{\cos \frac{\pi}{4}\cos \alpha+\sin \frac{\pi}{4}\sin \alpha}{\sin \alpha+\cos \alpha}=\frac{\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}(\sin \alpha+\cos \alpha)}{\sin \alpha+\cos \alpha}=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}$． | 课堂演练 |  |
| 选择题(单选) | 若 $\sin \alpha - \sin \beta = 1 - \dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$，$\cos \alpha - \cos \beta = \dfrac{1}{2}$，则 $\cos(\alpha - \beta)$ 的值为（　　）   A. $\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$　　B. $\dfrac{1}{2}$　　C. $\dfrac{3}{4}$　　D. $1$ | 3 | 余弦差角;平方和 | 答案: A   解析: 依题意，$(\sin \alpha - \sin \beta)^2 = \left(1 - \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right)^2$ ①，   $(\cos \alpha - \cos \beta)^2 = \left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^2$ ②，   ① + ② 得：   $$ \sin^2 \alpha - 2\sin \alpha \sin \beta + \sin^2 \beta + \cos^2 \alpha - 2\cos \alpha \cos \beta + \cos^2 \beta = \left(1 - \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right)^2 + \left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^2 $$   即   $$ (\sin^2 \alpha + \cos^2 \alpha) + (\sin^2 \beta + \cos^2 \beta) - 2(\cos \alpha \cos \beta + \sin \alpha \sin \beta) = 1 - \sqrt{3} + \frac{3}{4} + \frac{1}{4} $$   $$ 1 + 1 - 2\cos(\alpha - \beta) = 2 - \sqrt{3} $$   所以   $$ 2 - 2\cos(\alpha - \beta) = 2 - \sqrt{3} \quad \Rightarrow \quad \cos(\alpha - \beta) = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} $$   故选 A． | 综合运用 |  |
| 填空题 | $\cos(x+270^\circ)\cos(x-180^\circ)+\sin(x+270^\circ)\sin(x-180^\circ)$的值为__________． | 2 | 余弦差角;诱导公式 | 答案: $0$ \| 解析: 原式＝$\cos\bigl[(x+270^\circ)-(x-180^\circ)\bigr]=\cos(450^\circ)=\cos(360^\circ+90^\circ)=\cos 90^\circ=0$． | 课堂演练 |  |
| 填空题 | 已知$\sin \alpha = \frac{15}{17}$，$\alpha \in \left( \frac{\pi}{2}, \pi \right)$，则$\cos \left( \frac{\pi}{4} - \alpha \right)$的值为__________． | 3 | 余弦差角;象限符号 | 答案: $\dfrac{7\sqrt{2}}{34}$   解析: 因为 $\sin \alpha = \dfrac{15}{17}$，$\alpha \in \left( \dfrac{\pi}{2}, \pi \right)$，所以   $$ \cos \alpha = -\sqrt{1 - \sin^2 \alpha} = -\sqrt{1 - \left( \dfrac{15}{17} \right)^2} = -\dfrac{8}{17}. $$   因此，   $$ \cos\!\left( \dfrac{\pi}{4} - \alpha \right)  = \cos \dfrac{\pi}{4} \cos \alpha + \sin \dfrac{\pi}{4} \sin \alpha  = \dfrac{\sqrt{2}}{2} \cdot \left( -\dfrac{8}{17} \right) + \dfrac{\sqrt{2}}{2} \cdot \dfrac{15}{17}  = \dfrac{7\sqrt{2}}{34}. $$ | 课后巩固 |  |
| 填空题 | 在$\triangle ABC$中，$\sin A=\frac{4}{5}$，$\cos B=-\frac{12}{13}$，则$\cos (A-B)=$__________． | 3 | 余弦差角;三角形内角 | 答案: $-\dfrac{16}{65}$   解析: 因为 $\cos B = -\dfrac{12}{13}$，且 $0 < B < \pi$，所以 $\dfrac{\pi}{2} < B < \pi$，   $$ \sin B = \sqrt{1 - \cos^2 B} = \sqrt{1 - \left(-\dfrac{12}{13}\right)^2} = \dfrac{5}{13}, $$   又 $0 < A < \dfrac{\pi}{2}$，所以   $$ \cos A = \sqrt{1 - \sin^2 A} = \sqrt{1 - \left(\dfrac{4}{5}\right)^2} = \dfrac{3}{5}. $$   因此，   $$ \cos(A - B) = \cos A \cos B + \sin A \sin B = \dfrac{3}{5} \times \left(-\dfrac{12}{13}\right) + \dfrac{4}{5} \times \dfrac{5}{13} = -\dfrac{16}{65}. $$ | 综合运用 |  |
| 解答题 | 若 $0 < \alpha < \dfrac{\pi}{2}$，$-\dfrac{\pi}{2} < \beta < 0$，$\cos \alpha = \dfrac{1}{3}$，$\cos \dfrac{\beta}{2} = \dfrac{\sqrt{6}}{3}$，求 $\cos \left(\alpha - \dfrac{\beta}{2}\right)$ 的值． | 4 | 余弦差角;同角关系;象限判断 | 答案: $-\dfrac{\sqrt{6}}{9}$   解析: 由 $\cos \alpha = \dfrac{1}{3}$，$0 < \alpha < \dfrac{\pi}{2}$，得 $\sin \alpha = \dfrac{2\sqrt{2}}{3}$．   由 $\cos \dfrac{\beta}{2} = \dfrac{\sqrt{6}}{3}$，$-\dfrac{\pi}{4} < \dfrac{\beta}{2} < 0$，得 $\sin \dfrac{\beta}{2} = -\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{3}$．   所以   \[ \cos \left( \alpha - \dfrac{\beta}{2} \right)  = \cos \alpha \cos \dfrac{\beta}{2} + \sin \alpha \sin \dfrac{\beta}{2}  = \dfrac{1}{3} \cdot \dfrac{\sqrt{6}}{3} + \dfrac{2\sqrt{2}}{3} \cdot \left( -\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{3} \right)  = -\dfrac{\sqrt{6}}{9}． \] | 课后巩固 |  |
| 选择题(多选) | （多选）下列关于函数 $ f(x) = \cos\left(x + \frac{\pi}{4}\right)\cos x - \sin\left(x + \frac{\pi}{4}\right)\sin x $ 的性质叙述中，正确的是（　　）   A. 最小正周期为 $ \pi $；   B. 函数图象关于直线 $ x = \frac{3\pi}{8} $ 对称；   C. 函数图象关于直线 $ x = -\frac{\pi}{8} $ 对称；   D. 函数图象关于点 $ \left(-\frac{\pi}{8},\, 0\right) $ 对称。 | 4 | 余弦和角;周期性;对称性 | 答案: ABC   解析: 函数   $$ f(x) = \cos\left(x + \frac{\pi}{4}\right)\cos x - \sin\left(x + \frac{\pi}{4}\right)\sin x = \cos\left[\left(x + \frac{\pi}{4}\right) + x\right] = \cos\left(2x + \frac{\pi}{4}\right), $$   所以函数的最小正周期是 $\pi$，A 正确．   由 $2x + \frac{\pi}{4} = k\pi$，$k \in \mathbb{Z}$，得 $x = \frac{k\pi}{2} - \frac{\pi}{8}$，$k \in \mathbb{Z}$，所以函数图象关于直线 $x = \frac{k\pi}{2} - \frac{\pi}{8}$，$k \in \mathbb{Z}$ 对称，B、C 正确．   $$ f\left(-\frac{\pi}{8}\right) = \cos\left(2 \cdot \left(-\frac{\pi}{8}\right) + \frac{\pi}{4}\right) = \cos(0) = 1 \neq 0, $$   D 错误． | 拔高培优 |  |
| 填空题 | 若 $0 < \alpha < \dfrac{\pi}{2}$，$-\dfrac{\pi}{2} < \beta < 0$，$\cos\left(\dfrac{\pi}{4}+\alpha\right)=\dfrac{1}{3}$，$\cos\left(\dfrac{\pi}{4}-\dfrac{\beta}{2}\right)=\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{3}$，则   $\sin\left(\dfrac{\pi}{4}-\dfrac{\beta}{2}\right) = \, \underline{\phantom{\dfrac{\sqrt{6}}{3}}}$，   $\cos\left(\alpha+\dfrac{\beta}{2}\right) = \, \underline{\phantom{\dfrac{\sqrt{6}-2\sqrt{2}}{9}}}$． | 4 | 正弦余弦关系;余弦差角;综合求值 | 答案: $\dfrac{\sqrt{6}}{3}$; $\dfrac{5\sqrt{3}}{9}$   解析: 因为 $0 < \alpha < \dfrac{\pi}{2}$，所以 $\dfrac{\pi}{4} < \dfrac{\pi}{4} + \alpha < \dfrac{3\pi}{4}$．又因为 $\cos\left(\dfrac{\pi}{4} + \alpha\right) = \dfrac{1}{3}$，所以 $\sin\left(\dfrac{\pi}{4} + \alpha\right) = \dfrac{2\sqrt{2}}{3}$．   因为 $-\dfrac{\pi}{2} < \beta < 0$，所以 $\dfrac{\pi}{4} < \dfrac{\pi}{4} - \dfrac{\beta}{2} < \dfrac{\pi}{2}$．又因为 $\cos\left(\dfrac{\pi}{4} - \dfrac{\beta}{2}\right) = \dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{3}$，所以 $\sin\left(\dfrac{\pi}{4} - \dfrac{\beta}{2}\right) = \dfrac{\sqrt{6}}{3}$．   于是   $$ \cos\left(\alpha + \dfrac{\beta}{2}\right)  = \cos\left[\left(\dfrac{\pi}{4} + \alpha\right) - \left(\dfrac{\pi}{4} - \dfrac{\beta}{2}\right)\right]  = \cos\left(\dfrac{\pi}{4} + \alpha\right)\cos\left(\dfrac{\pi}{4} - \dfrac{\beta}{2}\right) + \sin\left(\dfrac{\pi}{4} + \alpha\right)\sin\left(\dfrac{\pi}{4} - \dfrac{\beta}{2}\right) = \dfrac{1}{3} \cdot \dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{3} + \dfrac{2\sqrt{2}}{3} \cdot \dfrac{\sqrt{6}}{3} = \dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{9} + \dfrac{2\sqrt{12}}{9} = \dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{9} + \dfrac{4\sqrt{3}}{9} = \dfrac{5\sqrt{3}}{9}. $$ | 拔高培优 |  |
| 解答题 | 已知角$\alpha$的顶点与原点$O$重合，始边与$x$轴的非负半轴重合，它的终边过点$P\left(-\dfrac{3}{5}, -\dfrac{4}{5}\right)$．   (1) 求$\sin(\alpha+\pi)$的值；   (2) 若角$\beta$满足$\sin(\alpha+\beta)=\dfrac{5}{13}$，求$\cos\beta$的值． | 4 | 三角函数定义;诱导公式;余弦差角 | 答案: (1) $\dfrac{4}{5}$；(2) $-\dfrac{56}{65}$ 或 $\dfrac{16}{65}$．   解析: (1) 由角 $\alpha$ 的终边过点 $P\left(-\dfrac{3}{5}, -\dfrac{4}{5}\right)$，得 $\sin \alpha = -\dfrac{4}{5}$，所以   \[ \sin(\alpha + \pi) = -\sin \alpha = \dfrac{4}{5}. \]   (2) 由角 $\alpha$ 的终边过点 $P\left(-\dfrac{3}{5}, -\dfrac{4}{5}\right)$，得 $\cos \alpha = -\dfrac{3}{5}$．   由 $\sin(\alpha + \beta) = \dfrac{5}{13}$，得 $\cos(\alpha + \beta) = \pm \dfrac{12}{13}$．   由 $\beta = (\alpha + \beta) - \alpha$，得   \[ \cos \beta = \cos(\alpha + \beta)\cos \alpha + \sin(\alpha + \beta)\sin \alpha, \]   代入得   \[ \cos \beta = \left(\pm \dfrac{12}{13}\right)\left(-\dfrac{3}{5}\right) + \left(\dfrac{5}{13}\right)\left(-\dfrac{4}{5}\right)  = \mp \dfrac{36}{65} - \dfrac{20}{65} =  \begin{cases} -\dfrac{56}{65}, & \text{取 } +\dfrac{12}{13} \text{ 时（即 } \cos(\alpha+\beta)=\dfrac{12}{13}\text{）},\\[1em] \dfrac{16}{65}, & \text{取 } -\dfrac{12}{13} \text{ 时（即 } \cos(\alpha+\beta)=-\dfrac{12}{13}\text{）}. \end{cases} \]   故 $\cos \beta$ 的值为 $-\dfrac{56}{65}$ 或 $\dfrac{16}{65}$． | 拔高培优 |  |
| 选择题(多选) | （多选）已知 $\alpha, \beta, \gamma \in \left(0, \dfrac{\pi}{2}\right)$，$\sin \alpha + \sin \gamma = \sin \beta$，$\cos \beta + \cos \gamma = \cos \alpha$，则下列说法正确的是（　　）   A. $\cos(\beta - \alpha) = \dfrac{1}{2}$　　B. $\cos(\beta - \alpha) = -\dfrac{1}{2}$　　C. $\beta - \alpha = \dfrac{\pi}{3}$　　D. $\beta - \alpha = -\dfrac{\pi}{3}$ | 5 | 余弦差角;平方和;恒等变形 | 答案：AC   解析：由已知得 $\sin \gamma = \sin \beta - \sin \alpha$，$\cos \gamma = \cos \alpha - \cos \beta$，两式分别平方相加，得   $$ (\sin \beta - \sin \alpha)^2 + (\cos \alpha - \cos \beta)^2 = 1, $$   展开并利用恒等式 $\sin^2 x + \cos^2 x = 1$，得   $$ \sin^2 \beta - 2 \sin \beta \sin \alpha + \sin^2 \alpha + \cos^2 \alpha - 2 \cos \alpha \cos \beta + \cos^2 \beta = 1. $$   整理得   $$ (\sin^2 \beta + \cos^2 \beta) + (\sin^2 \alpha + \cos^2 \alpha) - 2(\sin \beta \sin \alpha + \cos \beta \cos \alpha) = 1, $$   即   $$ 1 + 1 - 2 \cos(\beta - \alpha) = 1, $$   所以   $$ -2 \cos(\beta - \alpha) = -1, \quad \text{即} \quad \cos(\beta - \alpha) = \frac{1}{2}. $$   故 A 项正确，B 项错误；   又 $\gamma \in \left(0, \dfrac{\pi}{2}\right)$，所以 $\sin \gamma = \sin \beta - \sin \alpha > 0$，得 $\beta > \alpha$；   结合 $\cos(\beta - \alpha) = \dfrac{1}{2}$ 且 $\beta - \alpha \in (0, \pi)$，得 $\beta - \alpha = \dfrac{\pi}{3}$，故 C 项正确，D 项错误．   综上，选 AC． | 拔高培优 |  |
